Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 10 minutes Number of Servings: 4 Ingredients 1/4 cup peanut butter 1 3/4 cups banana (or any other fresh or canned and drained fruit) 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder 1 1/2 cups cold water Directions Put all ingredients in blender. Blend on low until smooth, and serve. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: To avoid peanuts or peanut butter, try sunflower seeds or sunflower seed butter.
